record.oneLiner: A hollow-crested duck-billed hadrosaur of western North America.
record.description: Lambeosaurus was a lambeosaurine 'duck-billed' hadrosaur of Late Cretaceous western North America, with a distinctive hollow head crest. It is the namesake of the lambeosaurine hadrosaurs.

notableFacts.text: Named for the hollow, often hatchet-shaped head crest characteristic of its group.
Named to honour paleontologist Lawrence Lambe.
